responsibility: Implements the Visium backend’s C-side target logic that complements visium.md and visium.h. This file defines the target hooks for ABI and calling convention handling, including argument passing, return-value location, varargs setup, pass-by-reference decisions, and interrupt-function attributes; manages per-function machine state such as frame layout and flag exposure; initializes Visium-specific libfuncs and builtins; emits and annotates prologue/epilogue, register save/restore, trampoline, and return sequences with correct CFA/unwind information; and provides target-specific reload, register-class, mode-change, block-operation, condition-code, address, and post-RTL helper routines used by expansion, reload, and final assembly generation for the Visium port.
same_name_distinction: The C implementation file for the Visium port: unlike visium.h it provides executable target-hook code and backend helper routines, unlike visium.md it implements logic that the machine description invokes or complements rather than defining RTL patterns and asm templates itself, and unlike visium.opt it consumes target option state instead of declaring the -m option set.
